name: Infoblox — Fast Flux DNS
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DNS Response" and xdm.event.outcome = "SUCCESS"
| alter domain    = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "query: (\S+) IN A"), 0),
        answer_ip = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, " IN A (\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0)
| filter domain != null and answer_ip != null
| bin _time span = 15m
| comp count_distinct(answer_ip) as flux_ips,
       values(answer_ip) as answer_ips
       by domain, _time
| filter flux_ips >= 50
| fields answer_ips, domain
description: One domain resolving to many distinct A-record IPs in short window.

TA0011 - Command and Control: T1568.001 - Dynamic Resolution: Fast Flux DNS
